findings.evidence: A search for `finalize_change` finds no match in any .py file. `template/scripts/post_review_finalization.py:121-125` still runs `openspec_lifecycle.py archive <change> --finalize` as a subprocess. The candidate diff touches no `post_review_finalization.py`. The spec requirement 'One finalize function archives a change' is behaviorally satisfied because `archive_change(..., finalize=True)` is that function. The proposal, design and tasks name an artifact that was not delivered, so they no longer match the code.
findings.summary: The proposal and tasks describe `openspec_lifecycle.finalize_change(root, change, *, context)` and say `post_review_finalization.trusted_archiver` archives through it (task 1.2 is ticked). No such function exists. The candidate only reworks `archive_change`, and `post_review_finalization.py` is unchanged.

findings.evidence: In `static_archive_problems`, `require_independent_review_receipt` runs only `if verification.is_file()`. When verification.md is absent there is no note that this check was skipped. `require_applicable_committed_diff` runs even when `require_committed_package` has already failed, and no dependency is reported. This is a mismatch with design.md line 3.
findings.summary: The design says a gate that depends on an earlier one must report the dependency explicitly instead of being skipped silently. The code skips some dependent gates without saying so.
